    // The inverse map, by the adjugate over the determinant. A singular matrix
    // (see CanInvert) yields the all-NaN matrix, as System.Numerics does rather
    // than signalling.
    Invert(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => self.CanInvert
            ? self.Adjugate * (1.0 / self.Determinant)
            : Matrix4x4.NotANumber;

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 decomposition

    // The homogeneous matrix whose three linear rows are the given axes and
    // whose translation row is the origin. The helper the decomposition rebuilds
    // its orthonormalized basis with.
    AxisMatrix(xAxis: Vector3D, yAxis: Vector3D, zAxis: Vector3D): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(xAxis.X, xAxis.Y, xAxis.Z, 0.0),
            Number4(yAxis.X, yAxis.Y, yAxis.Z, 0.0),
            Number4(zAxis.X, zAxis.Y, zAxis.Z, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));

    // The index (0, 1 or 2) of the largest of three numbers, ties going to the
    // earliest.
    IndexOfLargest(x: Number, y: Number, z: Number): Integer
        => x < y ? (y < z ? 2 : 1) : (x < z ? 2 : 0);

    // The index (0, 1 or 2) of the smallest of three numbers, ties going to the
    // earliest.
    IndexOfSmallest(x: Number, y: Number, z: Number): Integer
        => x < y ? (x < z ? 0 : 2) : (y < z ? 1 : 2);

    // The standard basis vector for an axis index: 0 -> X, 1 -> Y, 2 -> Z.
    CanonicalAxis(index: Integer): Vector3D
        => index == 0
            ? Vector3D.UnitX
            : (index == 1 ? Vector3D.UnitY : Vector3D.UnitZ);

    // A three-axis basis with one axis replaced.
    ReplaceAxis(basis: Array<Vector3D>, index: Integer, axis: Vector3D): Array<Vector3D>
        => [index == 0 ? axis : basis[0],
            index == 1 ? axis : basis[1],
            index == 2 ? axis : basis[2]];

    // A three-number triple with one element replaced.
    ReplaceElement(values: Array<Number>, index: Integer, value: Number): Array<Number>
        => [index == 0 ? value : values[0],
            index == 1 ? value : values[1],
            index == 2 ? value : values[2]];

    // The scale, rotation and translation the matrix is the product of, paired
    // with whether the extraction succeeded. Ported from System.Numerics: the
    // three linear rows give the scales; the rows are then visited longest-first,
    // each degenerate one (scale below 1e-4) rebuilt from a canonical axis or a
    // cross product so the basis stays complete; a negative determinant means a
    // mirrored basis, so the dominant axis and its scale are flipped. Extraction
    // fails — returning the identity rotation and `false` — when the repaired
    // basis is still not orthonormal (its determinant is not 1), which is what a
    // sheared matrix produces.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polar_decomposition
    Decompose(self: Matrix4x4): Tuple4<Number3, Quaternion, Vector3D, Boolean> {
        var eps = 0.0001;
        var translation = Vector3D(self.Row4.X, self.Row4.Y, self.Row4.Z);
        var row1 = Vector3D(self.Row1.X, self.Row1.Y, self.Row1.Z);
        var row2 = Vector3D(self.Row2.X, self.Row2.Y, self.Row2.Z);
        var row3 = Vector3D(self.Row3.X, self.Row3.Y, self.Row3.Z);
        var scales = [row1.Length, row2.Length, row3.Length];
        var a = IndexOfLargest(scales[0], scales[1], scales[2]);
        var c = IndexOfSmallest(scales[0], scales[1], scales[2]);
        var b = 3 - a - c;
        var basis0 = [row1, row2, row3];
        // The dominant axis: a canonical axis stands in when the row has no length.
        var axisA = (scales[a] < eps ? CanonicalAxis(a) : basis0[a]).Normalize;
        var basis1 = basis0.ReplaceAxis(a, axisA);
        // The middle axis: crossed against whichever canonical axis is least
        // aligned with the dominant one, so the product cannot be degenerate.
        var axisB = (scales[b] < eps
            ? axisA.Cross(CanonicalAxis(IndexOfSmallest(axisA.X.Abs, axisA.Y.Abs, axisA.Z.Abs)))
            : basis1[b]).Normalize;
        var basis2 = basis1.ReplaceAxis(b, axisB);
        // The last axis is determined by the other two.
        var axisC = (scales[c] < eps ? axisA.Cross(axisB) : basis2[c]).Normalize;
        var basis3 = basis2.ReplaceAxis(c, axisC);
        var det = AxisMatrix(basis3[0], basis3[1], basis3[2]).Determinant;
        var mirrored = det < 0.0;
        var basis = mirrored ? basis3.ReplaceAxis(a, -basis3[a]) : basis3;
        var scale = mirrored ? scales.ReplaceElement(a, -scales[a]) : scales;
        var absDet = mirrored ? -det : det;
        var ok = (absDet - 1.0) * (absDet - 1.0) <= eps;
        var rotationMatrix = AxisMatrix(basis[0], basis[1], basis[2]);
        return (Number3(scale[0], scale[1], scale[2]),
                ok ? Quaternion.CreateFromRotationMatrix(rotationMatrix) : Quaternion.Identity,
                translation,
                ok);
    }

    // The rotation part of the matrix, via the full decomposition so that a
    // scaled matrix still yields a unit quaternion. Falls back to the identity
    // when the matrix does not decompose.
    Rotation(self: Matrix4x4): Quaternion
        => self.Decompose.X1;

    // The translation part: the first three components of the translation row.
    Translation(self: Matrix4x4): Vector3D
        => (self.Row4.X, self.Row4.Y, self.Row4.Z);

    // The same matrix with a different translation; the linear block and the
    // projective element Row4.W are untouched.
    WithTranslation(self: Matrix4x4, translation: Vector3D): Matrix4x4
        => (self.Row1,
            self.Row2,
            self.Row3,
            Number4(translation.X, translation.Y, translation.Z, self.Row4.W));

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 construction — translation, scale, rotation

    // The homogeneous map that shifts by `position` and does nothing else.
    CreateTranslation(_: Matrix4x4, position: Vector3D): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0),
            Number4(position.X, position.Y, position.Z, 1.0));

    // The uniform scale about the origin.
    CreateScale(_: Matrix4x4, scale: Number): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(scale, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, scale, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, scale, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));

    // The per-axis scale about the origin.
    CreateScale(_: Matrix4x4, scales: Number3): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(scales.X, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, scales.Y, 0.0, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, scales.Z, 0.0),
            Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));

    // The rotation about the world X axis, right-handed.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix
    CreateRotationX(_: Matrix4x4, angle: Angle): Matrix4x4 {
        var c = angle.Cos;
        var s = angle.Sin;
        return (Number4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, c, s, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, -s, c, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }

    // The rotation about the world Y axis, right-handed.
    CreateRotationY(_: Matrix4x4, angle: Angle): Matrix4x4 {
        var c = angle.Cos;
        var s = angle.Sin;
        return (Number4(c, 0.0, -s, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
                Number4(s, 0.0, c, 0.0),
                Number4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0));
    }
